object.attr: stakeholder: a branch's commits keep their hashes through a merge, so links acknowledged on the branch stay OK, while a conflict resolution that makes new text makes them suspect. Taken together, so that a merge combining a file change and a figure change counts (CF-T26). Changed in 0.2.0.
object.description: Mellon shall count a merge commit as a change to the target only when the target object's file and figure, taken together, differ between the merge commit and each of its parents.
